toegepas.rede_vinder: In the original, 'hulle' can be read as 'their' (families play their board games) and 'elke dag' seems to cover the games too; a separate clause with its own subject fixes both and takes the AWS comma before 'en'.
toegepas.fout: After 'en', 'speel hulle bordspeletjies' reads first as 'play their board games' with no subject, and 'elke dag' seems to cover the games as well as the bread.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A separate clause with its own subject and the AWS comma removes the stumble, keeps 'elke dag' on the bread where it belongs, and leaves every protected word and qualifier intact.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The sentence compares a farmer's 'gesin' (household) with a rich 'familie' (extended family); 'gesin' on both sides makes the comparison parallel (the block heading would then still say 'familie', so the reviewer may prefer to leave this).
